clips.title: The story
paras: The Longshore is the expansive sandy coastline stretching along the entire western edge of Westfall. Despite its vast and scenic expanse, the shore is notoriously hazardous due to thick populations of aggressive murlocs and scattered wrecks off the coast.

Running the full western length of Westfall, the Longshore is one of the widest unbroken beaches in the Eastern Kingdoms. Yet it offers little peace to travelers. Coastal murlocs dominate the surf, led by notorious terrors like Old Murk-Eye, while the remnants of sunken vessels—including ruined elven destroyers—litter the shallows. Near the southern reaches, isolated settlers like Daphne Stilwell struggle against marauding Defias bandits, standing within sight of the Westfall Lighthouse across the water.
